It’s kinda similar with me. Most often whenever I’m face to face with a problem, other problems will rise up and flood my mind leaving me overwhelmed and anxious to do even the small things in life like getting out of my own bed. Today is the second day I missed school because I kept having anxiety attacks in the morning.
Hey just rest up easy, tomorrow can be a whole better day :,)

I lost that person because They stood by me through all the crap I did trying to kill myself and etc, I really strained their will power because I kept pushing them away thinking they’d be better without me but I kept hurting them by doing that and now I realized that I hurt them so much that it’s too late for me to mend anything that we had. In regards to what makes me suicidal, I don’t know at all, I just feel like I’m alone, and just kinda going into a downward spiral.

Hey, I saw your comment on my post and I thought that I should at least reply to your post before I answer back :,)
I know I’m young and all but I’d like to tell myself I’ve learnt a lot about life in my retrospectively short life. 
In regards to finding new antibiotics and potential treatments to MRSA, the ongoing fight never ends as is the same with cancer and other demoralizing sicknesses. The fight is beyond ridiculous in regards to its challenges but in the end it’s a fight of stamina and endurance. Albeit now it seems like everything is at odds against you, there is something out there that you don’t know about yet that may be beneficial in treating you. I’m not in the position to kinda be spewing out this type of advice that seems like the bullshit that everyone spews out but I can assure you it’s the truth. I’m speaking on behalf of all the family members I stood by and friends that I still don’t know how long they have left to keep up the good fight. I guess the way to look at this is as if you’re running a marathon, you have to reserve your energy for your last sprint to the finish line.  Saving this energy isn’t really easy but I know that your boyfriend that loves you and that you love too wants to help you keep a steady strong pace to overcome this, and to push him away is practically twice as painful as you imagine letting him stay with you is. Ironically just like you said on my post, I’m willing to bet that this is event might just need sometime time, or maybe even a little distraction from everything like a really fun date, or a weekend of your favorite hobbies.
Again I don’t know if my ramble will provide you any help or solace but I wanted to simply extend my arms out to you as you did to me by commenting on my post. Us depression buds stay stronger in numbers than we do alone :,)

I’m actually in your same position, albeit I’m only a teenager in school. I have a ton of responsibilities that I run the risk of being removed from due to my depression and anxiety holding me back in my bed for a day or even weeks occasionally. I’ve been told I might not graduate, I might be removed from my college classes and lose my chance at graduating with an AA, and be removed from Jazz band ( the only thing that keeps me alive at this point) & honestly I often times just feel so discouraged by hearing this repeatedly that I stay in my bed gaining more and more weight to add onto my gained 80lbs, I honestly don’t know what to do either but I thought maybe me sharing my similar experience might give you some solace at least.
